DB_TYPE.description: Database engine: postgres for production, sqlite for local dev

PG_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server (localhost in local dev)

PG_DATABASE.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to connect to for Keycloak

PG_USERNAME.description: Username for authenticating with the PostgreSQL database

PG_PASSWORD.description: Authentication password for connecting to the PostgreSQL database

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Initial admin username for master realm; default is 'admin'

KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password for master realm; required on first startup

KC_PROXY.description: Proxy mode: edge for Railway TLS termination (default), passthrough, or reencrypt

KC_HTTP_ENABLED.description: Enable Keycloak HTTP listener; set false for HTTPS-only via Railway

KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME.description: Public URL users access Keycloak at (must match your Railway domain)

PORT.description: Port the service listens on inside the container
